# Dreo cloud fixtures

Real answers of the Dreo cloud (device list and device states), taken from the
test suite of [`hass-dreo`](https://github.com/JeffSteinbok/hass-dreo)
(`tests/pydreo/api_responses/`), then trimmed and anonymized: device ids
invented, serial numbers replaced by the fixture names, Wi-Fi names, MAC
addresses and signal values removed, device names rewritten.
